## History

Phillips served as a local schoolmaster and boarded at Eben Wright's house. During his time at the school, he disciplined [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) by making her stand at the blackboard after she smashed her slate over [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) Blythe's head. On a later occasion, he publicly punished [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for being late by forcing her to sit next to [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), leading [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to temporarily quit attending his school.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--phillips.md)

Mr. Phillips serves as Anne's school teacher, but their relationship is defined by harsh discipline and resentment. He repeatedly singles her out for public punishments, forcing her to stand at the blackboard after she smashes her slate over [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) Blythe's head, and later forcing her to sit next to [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) for being late. These humiliating disciplinary actions deeply upset [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), leading her to temporarily refuse to return to his school before she eventually bids him a emotional farewell on his final day as teacher.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), +10 more_

- Mentor of — school teacher  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013)</sub>

### [Minnie Andrews](../character/minnie-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/minnie-andrews--phillips.md)

[Minnie Andrews](../character/minnie-andrews.md) is a pupil in Mr. Phillips's schoolroom. She attends the school alongside the other local children through Mr. Phillips's tenure, remaining a student there up until his final day of teaching.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P0](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P16](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P19](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0019), +6 more_
